notes.title: Recent works
notes.content:
Feel excited that you could come to our stand in Gamescom, Colonge. We did't expected that there are lots of players still concern the development of Bullet Sorrow. 

In this case, we'd like to share our recent work. The first and the most important, we are still working on this game. We are recently doing the porting for other platforms and more information will be announced soon. Second, we will consider to continue improving this game, the content or the feature.

To make this game better, we need your help. Send us your feedback, suggestions or any good idea.

Thank you all. :D

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.0.5 Teleport Back in New Modes
notes.content:
Now locomotion is optional in multi-player mode and infinite mode, which means you can choose either teleport or free locomotion before the game starts:).  

We also think it is somehow weird to put two types of movements together in one game, yet we could not figure out better solution for now in a short time. We'd be really interested in getting to know how you guys think of the this update, and any new thought will be so much welcomed.

Other changes:

 [*] Leaderboard and server data zeroed.

Emergence -- Lobby bugs
notes.content:
As reported, there are game rooms remain in the list, which are empty virtually; players with same name in one room.

These are problems caused by a server bug, the residual info has't been swapped from the server successfully. We are trying to figure it out and will fix it asap.

Most (10/10) rooms are not available.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Enmergency Update 1.1.0.1---Crashes Fixed and Movement Coming Next Week!
notes.content:
Hey folks, 

Plz download and install this update immediately, if you met a crash. 

Believe it or not, the last thing we want is to let you down in this version:(, we are really happy and feel lucky to have you guys in the community for last 4 months.  And these two day we've been trying very hard to test and solve the crash and server problems. 

It is a relief for me that we worked the problem out today, so update it immediately, hope now you can do fine with the game.

There would probably be another update by tomorrow, to further fix the connection and stability.

[h1] About Movement	[/h1]

We finally worked out a nice way to manage a free trackpad/thumb stick locomotion. Will be applied in next week's update very soon!

Updated 1.1 Full Released! And Demo is Back!
Updated 1.1 Full Released! And Demo is Back!
Coming Soon on 17 April! New Trailer Update.
notes.content:
Actually this is more of a delay announcement...ːsteamboredː 

15 April was our original full release date, and also a date to increase the price. Now we just need to delay it for 2 days.  Since Easter is not an conditional holiday here, we think we can still have some time to test the PVP mode repeatedly before Monday :), then release with more certainty.

Please notice that the price will still be increased on 15 April. And I'd love to share two additional news of the coming version:

1. [b]Optimization for Oculus Users Done [/b]. Rotation for facing direction 
    added, 
    will be more fair on cross-platform competition;

2. [b]Save Points Added [/b]. There will be several saving opportunities in easy 
    and middle difficulties.

You could see most new features in our latest trailer I just uploaded.

notes.title: Temporary Demo Off Store
notes.content:
We'd been hesitant about this decision for quite a long time. 

Since we are seriously lack of time to fix the demo to a standard of current version; On the other hand, we had not changed our mind on always to share a free demo, so more people could enjoy our work~

However, after some days of observation, it seems that bugs in this demo has been kicking new players away from Bullet Sorrow VR (thanks to the remind from ID: yngndrw).
 
So we think we just have to cancel the demo for a short time, and it will probably soon be back around April 15th, right after a comprehensive optimization.

Thanks for the concern.

notes.title: 1.0.4.1 Some bugs fixed for Oculus
notes.content:
Sorry just hadn't notice that I failed to post this announcement early this morning, now here it is:


1. Fixed occasionally control problem for Oculus Touch: now the "A" button would not switch to the stick anymore when jumping out of a heavy gun tower;

2. Fixed occasionally character sunk down problem while choosing stages. 

My apology for not as focus on the community here recently, ever since the whole team has been devoted themselves in the full version(multi-player) of this game.  

We still really need you guys very much on feedbacks and suggestions, especially there will be a lot more new stuffs adding to the full version:)
I'll try my best to response more quickly from now on. 

Thanks and all the best!

notes.title: Upgraded new version, optimized fluency and also the Blink!
notes.content:
We think we found the cause why some players got  framerate problem. This upgrade probably could solve it totally. 

We also modified the cool down time for Locomotion, we added 3 blink power bars to it, every blink would cost 1 bar, the bars is recharging over time, so you can plan how to use the moving chance with strategy.

We are going to make upgrades every week until the final version come, suggestions are always welcomed anytime. 

Thanks again for liking the demo!
